f1003r1aCorrectionsApplied.note: F1-003-R1 (2026-07-28) found this task's own §5/§9 claim — that test:kvkk-lifecycle (kvkkAttachmentImagingLifecycle.test.ts) requires a live MinIO/S3-compatible instance, carried forward unverified from F1-002-P1_test_script_reconciliation.json's externalServiceRequired=true/externalServiceDetail=["aws-s3"] field — to be an objective factual error. Direct inspection of the test file: every code path the test exercises calls through S3Client.prototype.send, and every one of those call sites is mocked (no live network/S3 endpoint is contacted at any point the test reaches). F1-003-P1's original claim was never independently re-verified against the actual test file — it was carried forward from F1-002-P1's static externalServiceRequired flag, which is a coarser signal (import-presence) than actual exercised-path analysis. Corrected: test:kvkk-lifecycle requires PostgreSQL (databaseRequired remains true, unchanged) but does NOT require a live MinIO instance; its S3 provider is mocked; externalNetworkRequired remains false. This correction narrows, not widens, the runtime requirement — no test behavior, script, or application code was changed to produce it. test:file-backup-db-integration (fileBackupDbIntegration.test.ts) remains the sole genuine MinIO-dependent target in the entire 114-record contract. This is a narrow evidence correction (F1-003-R1A) over F1-003-P1's merged record — P1's own historical execution status, counts, and narrative are preserved elsewhere in this document and in the companion MD report; only the specific stale MinIO claim is corrected here and everywhere it was mechanically derived from.
